summary: At his cubicle, Neo is handed a softpak by a Federal Express Guy; inside is a cellular phone that rings the moment he holds it. On the line is Morpheus, who tells Neo he has been looking for him and that 'they're coming for you,' warning he is unsure 'what they're going to do.' Neo stands slowly and peeks over the partition to see Agent Smith, Agent Brown and Agent Jones leading a group of cops, and a female employee points out his cubicle. Morpheus guides his escape: Neo lunges into the empty cubicle across the hall just as the Agents turn into his row, crams himself into a dark corner clutching the phone, and hides while the Agents search his empty cubicle and a cop is sent to the bathroom. Following Morpheus's whispered instructions, Neo rolls out, freezes right behind a cop who has just turned around, then sneaks down the row and shoots across the opening to the first office on the left.

what_changes.before: Curious about the mysterious caller, asking 'Do you know who this is?' and greeting 'Morpheus...'
what_changes.after: Confronted with the reality that forces are closing in, asking 'Who's coming for me?' and 'What the hell do they want with me?!'
what_changes.evidence: MORPHEUS (V.O.) I've been looking for you, Neo. I don't know if you're ready to see what I want to show you, but unfortunately, we have run out of time. They're coming for you, Neo.

what_changes.before: Exposed at his desk, physically collapsing: 'Neo's knees give and he sinks into his chair.'
what_changes.after: Hidden and in motion, following Morpheus's guidance to escape the closing search.
what_changes.evidence: Neo crams himself into a dark corner, clutching the phone tightly to him.

what_changes.before: Hesitant and questioning: 'Right now?' and 'But what if...?'
what_changes.after: Acting decisively on Morpheus's commands: 'Go! Now!' prompts him to lunge across the hall.
what_changes.evidence: Neo lunges across the hall, diving into the other cubicle just as the Agents turn into his row.

event_hint.one_line: Agents and cops raid Neo's office to seize him, while Morpheus phones to guide his escape through the cubicle maze.

uncertain: Whether the female employee who points out Neo's cubicle acts knowingly or incidentally.
What the Agents specifically intend to do to Neo, since Morpheus says 'I'm not sure what they're going to do.'

minds.wants: To survive the closing raid by following Morpheus's instructions exactly, while understanding what is happening to him and why these people want him.
minds.feels: Terrified and physically overwhelmed — his knees give out, he sweats, his eyes pop — but also carried forward by a strange trust in a voice that has been hunting him through messages. The fear is real, but so is a dawning willingness to be led, because the alternative (staying to find out what they'll do) is worse.
minds.shows: A man trying to stay small and quiet: ducking below the partition, cramming into a dark corner, clutching the phone, freezing mid-motion behind a cop. His questions ('Who's coming for me?', 'What the hell do they want with me?!') leak out because he cannot contain them, but his body obeys.
minds.basis: His knees give when he hears Morpheus's name; he asks repeated 'why' questions; he follows each command ('Go! Now!' → he lunges; 'Now.' → he rolls out and freezes). The physical terror is stated outright (sweat, popping eyes).

believes_about.belief: This mysterious, possibly dangerous figure is now his only lifeline and can be trusted to get him out.
believes_about.wrong_because: He has no real basis for this trust beyond desperation; Morpheus is using him and has a larger agenda (the 'ready to see what I want to show you' framing) that Neo does not yet understand.

believes_about.belief: They are law enforcement come to arrest a hacker — a knowable, ordinary threat with a knowable goal.
believes_about.wrong_because: They are not ordinary cops and their interest in him is not ordinary law enforcement; Morpheus explicitly says he is unsure what they'll do, and the event shape shows Smith intends to physically modify Neo into an informant, something Neo cannot yet conceive.

believes_about.belief: She is just another coworker who happened to point him out, an incidental betrayal.
believes_about.wrong_because: Uncertain — she may have knowingly identified him, or may simply be reacting to the commotion; Neo cannot tell, and neither can we.

minds.wants: To extract Neo from the office before the Agents reach him, by commanding his movements turn-by-turn through the phone.
minds.feels: Intense, controlled urgency — he has been watching/waiting for this moment ('I've been looking for you'), and now time has collapsed. There is a deliberate quality to him: he tests Neo's readiness even in the middle of a raid, and he is calm enough to whisper.
minds.shows: A voice that is authoritative and unhurried relative to the danger, issuing short commands and small reassurances ('A little longer...'). He lets almost nothing through except instruction, because Neo can only act on instruction, not on Morpheus's own fear.
minds.basis: He narrates the threat ('They're coming for you'), then converts it immediately into guidance; he paces Neo ('Do it slowly'), times the hiding ('Stay here for a moment... A little longer'), and drops to a whisper to avoid detection.

believes_about.belief: Neo may not yet be ready ('I don't know if you're ready to see what I want to show you'), but he will obey under pressure.
believes_about.wrong_because: Inferred — Morpheus is gambling that fear will make Neo compliant, and that the raid will serve as the push Morpheus has been unable to give him through messages alone.

believes_about.belief: They are a lethal, unpredictable threat whose intentions toward Neo he genuinely cannot forecast ('I'm not sure what they're going to do').
believes_about.wrong_because: Not wrong — this is the one belief the text confirms as honest uncertainty, and he is careful to transmit that uncertainty rather than reassure falsely.

minds.wants: To locate and seize the hacker Thomas Anderson, closing the net methodically with the cops.
minds.feels: Cold, unhurried certainty that the prey is cornered. He is not running; he is conducting a search he expects to succeed, which is why he enters Neo's cubicle himself rather than delegating.
minds.shows: Only organized movement — leading the group, turning into the row, searching the empty cubicle. He lets nothing of his interior show because there is no one here whose reaction matters to him; the office is a problem to be solved, not a scene to be played.
minds.basis: He leads the cops, moves 'quickly towards the cubicle,' enters Neo's empty cubicle personally, and while Neo hides, Brown is calmly talking to another employee — the search is confident, not frantic.

believes_about.belief: Anderson is trapped in his cubicle and will be taken; there is no way out of a sealed office floor surrounded by agents and police.
believes_about.wrong_because: Confirmed by the scene's outcome — Neo escapes by following Morpheus's guidance, slipping past a cop and out of the row while Smith searches an empty space. Smith's certainty about containment is exactly what lets Neo get behind him.

minds.wants: To complete a delivery and leave — this is a transaction, not an involvement.
minds.feels: Nothing particular; he is a functionary in a system, unaware that the package he hands over is a lifeline and a trigger.
minds.shows: A flat, routine courtesy ('Have a nice day') that is chilling precisely because it is so ordinary against what the package contains.
minds.basis: He confirms identity, has Neo sign, hands over the softpak, and delivers a stock pleasantry — no awareness of the phone, the call, or the raid to follow.

believes_about.belief: Just a recipient to be signed off to, an ordinary office worker getting a package.
believes_about.wrong_because: He has no idea this man is the target of an imminent raid, or that he has just delivered the instrument of his escape.

minds.wants: inferred: Either to cooperate with the authorities by identifying the target, or simply to answer a question / redirect an alarming commotion toward the source.
minds.feels: Uncertain — the text gives no interior access; she may be frightened, compliant, or merely reactive.
minds.shows: A single gesture — turning and pointing out Neo's cubicle — that is legible to everyone in the room (the Agents, Neo) but whose motive she keeps to herself.
minds.basis: She 'turns and points out Neo's cubicle' the instant the Agents arrive; nothing else about her is shown. The scene itself flags her intent as uncertain.

believes_about.belief: Uncertain and unreadable from the page — she may know exactly who he is (a suspect to be handed over) or may simply be pointing at the man she thinks the commotion is about.
believes_about.wrong_because: The scene deliberately withholds this; any single reading would be invention. The drama is in the ambiguity itself.

connects_back: Rhineheart's ultimatum in sc-016 ('either you're on time or you find another job') — Neo is at his desk, having just absorbed that lecture, when the phone/raid arrives, so the ordinary authority threat is instantly replaced by a real one.
The window cleaners on the scaffolding in sc-016, which Neo was staring at — they become the escape route Morpheus will try to use (and the event shape confirms Neo attempts the scaffold next).
The 'special, rules don't apply to you' charge from Rhineheart, which the raid makes literal: the rules really are about to stop applying, in a way neither Rhineheart nor Neo yet understands.
The phone Morpheus has been using to reach Neo in earlier, off-page contact — this is the escalation from cryptic messages ('Follow the white rabbit') to direct, operational guidance.
sets_up: ev-003: Neo's failed escape — the phone guidance buys him movement but the office is sealed, so he is driven to the window/scaffold, drops the phone, and is captured and taken to the white room where Smith interrogates and physically modifies him.
The physical modification of Neo (sealed mouth, tracking bug) that Smith performs in ev-003, which is only possible because the raid here succeeds in cornering and capturing him.
Neo's established willingness to obey a commanding voice under pressure — the template for his later trust of Morpheus and, eventually, taking the red pill in ev-006.
The Agents' demonstrated ability to locate Neo inside the Matrix, raising the stakes that force Morpheus to move quickly toward revealing himself and offering the way out (ev-004).
dramatic_function: To collapse Neo's ordinary world in a single breath — the mundane delivery and the boss's petty ultimatum are instantly overwritten by a real, lethal pursuit — and to convert him from a passive recipient of cryptic messages into an active fugitive who must trust and obey an unseen guide, launching the plot out of mystery and into physical danger.
